summary: Today’s tone is mixed-to-risk-off: crypto majors are broadly weaker, while Reuters shows tech stocks and Nasdaq futures getting some support from AI optimism. Oil remains volatile and elevated, gold is firm to mixed, and several altcoin/major-crypto setups are still being framed as selective rather than broad-based risk-on.
